Yash Breaks From Ramayana LA Promotions for Disneyland Outing With Kids, Times of India Reports

Reported Details From Times of India

According to Times of India, actor Yash paused promotions for his upcoming film *Ramayana: Rise of a Legend* in Los Angeles to spend a day at Disneyland with his children. The report says his children had accompanied him to the film’s premiere.

Cast Comments Cited in the Report

The article references a behind-the-scenes video from the cast’s promotional activities in Los Angeles. Reported remarks include:

  • Yash: “I’m going to Disneyland with my kids. LA first time, but I have been to Orlando.”
  • Ranbir Kapoor: “For me also, Disneyland and Universal Studios.”
  • Sai Pallavi: reportedly said she was looking forward to visiting Century City Mall.
  • The cast also reportedly expressed interest in visiting the Broad Museum and the iconic Chinese Theatre.

Release Information

Times of India reports that *Ramayana: Rise of a Legend* is set to release on November 5, with special screenings and early previews reportedly scheduled for November 4. The film is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and stars Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravi Dubey as Lakshmana, among others.

The report also describes Ranbir Kapoor’s appearance on an American morning news programme as “surreal,” quoting him as saying he had studied in New York but found the studio experience humbling and amazing.

Weather and Practical Implications

According to the report, Ranbir Kapoor said Yash had been watching the weather forecast because he was nervous about taking his children out. Yash reportedly confirmed he had received the weather report.

Readers planning around the film’s release should treat the November 5 date and November 4 preview information as reported, not independently confirmed. Official studio or distributor announcements should be checked for final screening dates, ticket availability, and venue details.

How to Verify the Original Announcement

The source material can be reviewed on the Times of India website in its entertainment section. Additional confirmation may be sought through verified social media accounts of the cast and the film’s official production or distribution channels.

Unknowns

The source does not state whether Yash’s Disneyland visit has already occurred, nor does it provide exact ticket details, screening venues, or official attendance figures for the premiere or previews.
